title: German chocolate cake
hookLine: Crackly bakery top, molten cocoa core — ready for your next TikTok taste test.

items.name: Toasted chopped pecans, almonds, or hazelnuts

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {eu17_main} and {eu17_but} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Shiny Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {eu17_main} and {eu17_but} together, whisk in {eu17_sug}, then fold in {eu17_dry} until glossy. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.

steps.title: Bake Until Crinkly Top & Fudgy Center
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 22 minutes until shiny crackle top forms and center stays fudgy. Let German chocolate cake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 9 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Pull slightly early for maximum gooey fudge center.
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer German chocolate cake to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 9 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
